parties.respondent: Vikash Tiwary @ Bikash Tiwary @ Bikash Nath

summary: Intra-State prison transfer of convict; High Court quashed transfer order; challenge based on principles of natural justice, security concerns, and prejudice to defense; transfer upheld if based on tangible security inputs; Saeed Sohail Sheikh and Sunil Batra distinguished; convict's right to defend in pending cases considered; mala fide transfer suspicion raised; adverse impact of distant transfer on undertrial rights emphasized; appeal allowed or dismissed based on security rationale.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned order set aside; transfer order upheld in interest of prison security and inmate safety.
